understanding lucid dreaming a state of conscious dream control lucid dreaming refers to a state in which individuals are fully aware that they are dreaming allowing them to actively participate in and manipulate the dream environment this unique phenomenon provides a playground for the conscious mind within the realm of dreams 1 awareness within the dream lucid dreamers maintain consciousness while navigating the dream landscape realizing that the events unfolding are products of their own imagination this heightened awareness distinguishes lucid dreams from typical dreaming experiences 2 active participation lucid dreamers can actively engage with the dream narrative interact with dream characters and make intentional decisions the dreamer becomes both the protagonist and director of their dream storyline 3 manipulating the dream environment lucid dreamers possess the ability to influence the dream environment changing elements such as scenery weather or even their own appearance this manipulation occurs in realtime reflecting the dreamers conscious desires anecdotes and studies on vividness and control 1 vividness of lucid dreams sarah a frequent lucid dreamer describes the vividness of her dreams with remarkable detail she recounts experiences of feeling textures tasting flavors and experiencing emotions with a heightened intensity beyond waking life 2 control over dream elements mark an avid lucid dreamer shares an anecdote of flying over surreal landscapes during a lucid dream he describes the sensation of controlling his flight path effortlessly reveling in the freedom and exhilaration of the experience 3 scientific studies on lucid dreaming studies using neuroimaging techniques such as functional magnetic resonance imaging fmri have explored the brain activity associated with lucid dreaming research suggests that during lucid dreaming regions of the brain associated with selfawareness and decisionmaking are highly activated supporting the idea of conscious control within dreams 4 application of lucid dreaming techniques lucid dreaming techniques such as reality checks and dream journaling have been studied for their effectiveness in inducing and enhancing lucid dreams anecdotal evidence from individuals practicing these techniques highlights improved dream recall increased frequency of lucid dreams and enhanced control over dream content in essence lucid dreaming offers a fascinating intersection of consciousness and imagination anecdotes and scientific studies alike emphasize the vividness and control experienced by lucid dreamers what you need to know age recommendations matter most vr headset manufacturers suggest waiting until kids are at least 1213 years old this isnt just a random number younger childrens eyes are still developing and extended vr use could potentially cause strain or discomfort the interpupillary distance space between eyes in younger kids also doesnt match most headset designs the good stuff vr technology can offer some real benefits for kids when used properly educational games and experiences can make learning super engaging your child could explore ancient egypt walk through the human body or practice a new language in virtual environments many kids also find vr great for creative activities like virtual painting or building what to watch out for motion sickness is pretty common especially when kids first start using virtual reality some children get nauseous or dizzy after just a few minutes youll also want to make sure your kid takes regular breaks experts recommend 15minute sessions max for younger users physical safety is another concern when wearing a vr headset kids cant see their real surroundings and might bump into furniture or walls always clear the play area and supervise younger children setting limits time limits are crucial with any vr headset even older kids shouldnt use vr for hours at a time start with short sessions and see how your child reacts watch for eye strain headaches or balance issues afterward making the right choice if you decide vr is right for your family look for headsets with adjustable settings and parental controls suitable for kids but age and supervision matter a lot if your child is over 12 enjoys technology and you can monitor their usage virtual reality might be a fun addition to their activities just time the last couple days to play through them and some others i just hadnt had time to play yet and wanted to give small reviews here but before those a quick reminder that this is the last week to participate in the 2025 incremental games player survey i played outhold which was a lot of fun ive been a fan of tower defense games since the flash days and its interesting to see it brought into the incremental game genre theres an interesting design complication in that incremental growth makes strategy less important than it would be in a pure tower defense and you can see vsrious tower defense games with meta progression like gemcraft or blooms td handle that differently outhold used multiple currencies to do so and in my playthrough i found that the grindable resources became increasingly less relevant towards the endgame and it became more and more about strategy to the point where postgame even arbitrarily limited the amounts of currencies you could use in a way reminiscent of chimps challenges from bloons overall very fun although those not interested in tower defense games for the strategy aspect may not find the postgame interesting i also played through a game about feeding a black hole which was quite fun a tad linear but i found the core gameplay and visuals interesting enough and new mechanics introduced regularly enough that it was quite compelling the team behind this game has also committed to implementing several different game modes and i played through the beta for the roguelike mode ill talk about the idea of roguelike modes in incremental games more below but ill just say i think this one is likely a good deal away from being ready to leave beta and i hope they dont stick to using a tree structure for the upgrades but between that mode enough once you get to around sector 25 where the difficulty curve tapers off and each set of 5 sectors feels the exact same finally i took a bit of time to explore astro prospector new roguelike mode honestly it is an interesting idea to combine nodebusterlike and roguelike game modes in the same package i like it as the solution to the complaint that nodebusterlikes are too short suddenly it has replayability and unlocks that can go far longer than the nodebusterlike campaign it might become even further removed from what someone who wants a traditional incremental game experience wants though gosh ive really had nodebusterlikes on the mind lately perhaps ill have to put that towards something productive

my likes and dislikes on volume 2 all in all this volume landed really well for me and felt meticulously put together scott clarkes involvement was a solid addition to the team especially the way his physics knowledge helped pinpoint the locations i also loved seeing dustin work through everything using dr brenners book the camzotz plot was strong with holly and max navigating memories together and it was satisfying to watch them both hold onto something that grounds and supports them i also predicted several beats and the broader direction of henry attempting to merge the dimensions my full thought process is here that said i really wanted more time spent inside vecnas memories with holly and max and more attention given to henrys story it doesnt feel fully resolved especially with only one episode left to explore what happened to henry and the incident at the cave that part of the story needs space to breathe if it is going to feel layered and meaningful and its clear the duffer brothers are running out of time if it isnt handled properly here the play will have to carry that weight entirely when it lands on netflix another major issue for me was how several characters were treated in this volume firstly will byers his coming out scene felt rushed to the point of being unsatisfying i get the stakes were high but this is about his identity and individuality something slowly built over multiple seasons only to be crammed into a single scene it didnt feel personal or significant especially with so many people in the room some of whom have no real connection to will part of the problem is that nothing is given time to develop every conversation introduces new problems and everyone suddenly already has the answers when will first sat down with joyce which by the way was important because will needed to have a hearttoheart with someone mike interrupts them and that disrupts the flow of their conversation then suddenly will decides to invite everyone with so many people present the moment lost its intimacy it stopped feeling like a personal revelation and more like the show spelling out his gayness for everyone it was like checking of boxes for the episoden his feelings of love the ones that led him to accept himself and those that are tied to his happiest memories were flattened he could have opened up with joyce jonathan or even eleven people he shares real closeness with but instead it happened in front of several others this is a comingofage story centered on will and that defining part of his identity deserved far more care another major problem for me was jancy my hope for their relationship collapsed i loved their confession scene the honesty in their conversation about their flaws and lies in that moment it felt like they were moving toward something grounded and healthy learning later that the duffer brothers confirmed their breakup was jarring jancy is a layered complicated relationship and that complexity was brushed aside far too easily when the ring was thrown away i initially read it as a sign of slowing down and reassessing signaling that their relationship would evolve slowly finding out it symbolized a breakup made the moment bleak to me i do want nancy to have her independent arc and i remember her saying she didnt know what she wanted but breaking them up at that point felt misplaced that should have been the moment for compromise and growth and that conversation was intimate and romantic so calling it a breakup instead feels wrong another thing that didnt sit right with me is kalis arc she is els sister and an important figure in her life when they first met kali helped el understand her powers and recognize her strength now their reunion feels hollow i get that kali has been through a lot with dr kay but she doesnt sound like the sisterly figure from the lost sister episode that bond built on guidance and togetherness is gone kali encouraging el to vanish by dying overrides everything both of them have endured in the lab people who have been experimented on and exploited shouldnt have to face that suggestion after all they survived i understand why kali wants el to disappear so the government wont keep hunting her but urging her to give up her own life so they wont come after her undermines everything el has survived her confidence and hope are essential to facing vecna and kalis influence here feels diminishing rather than supportive she essentially suggested el abandon her family and die alongside her so the government wont track them the same government el has spent months escaping and the same government she has gone against and outsmarted el herself proposes leaving hawkins but kali dismisses it while imposing her idea hopper goes from being glad to see els sister to deeply distrusting her as his instincts signal she isnt good for el kali even calls herself a bad influence on el the way they are moving with 008 it feels as if either shes going to sacrifice for eleven or shes going to be a bad influence and cause el to make a bad decision i just dont like that because i expected kali to be the one anchoring el but it seems that she wants to be the one making the decision for her she even gives eleven the look in the truck almost as if theyre going through with the plan she made its so sad because eleven grew up believing shes the monster and now shes willing to put an end to it in the worst way possible maybe she wont go through with the decision but she wouldnt be doing it if it wasnt for kali another reason kali is starting to feel frustrating is how she eavesdrops on els conversation with mike a private moment between the two of them she overhears it and dismisses everything as just a dream completely ignoring that dreams can bleed into reality el even acknowledges to mike that the outcome hes describing might be unrealistic yet kali doubles down reinforcing it in the long run this could make el doubt that shes capable of a happy ending which could erode her hope and make her more hesitant to trust in possibilities i dont know what to feel about kali because im neutral on whether shes going to be helpful for eleven she was a great mentor before but i havent seen her mentorship in season 5 yet either ways im ready to watch it all play out in the finale

attempt to explain a potential reason as to why in the last federal election the liberals surged in the maritimes while the conservatives surged in newfoundland theres a version of this series on substack that includes pictures embedded videos if youre interested in reading this essay there so far in this series ive looked at how canadas socialist movement has traditionally had something of a tory touch in terms of its philosophy and attitude while the influence of this tory touch within the ccfndp has waxed waned over the years it has always been present within the ccfndp coalition in some form or another what better area to explore this idea of tory touched socialism than the region which received the bulk of the united empire loyalists following the american revolution the maritimes as the ndp has been most successful in the maritimes in nova scotia this essay will seek to help define what socialism may mean for modern nova scotians for nonatlantic canadian readers one part of atlantic canadian political culture that i think gets often overlooked is how newfoundland often gets lumped in with the maritimes despite newfoundland having its own unique history and identity compared to the rest of english canada this essay also seeks to explore some of the subtle yet profound differences in these otherwise very similar regions that make up atlantic canada i hope in doing so i will also be able to help better define nova scotian political culture as well to start things off i found it very interesting that when i looked at the 2025 federal election results for atlantic canada compared with the 2021 federal election results i noticed that the ndp vote seemingly broke in the exact opposite direction in atlantic canadas two regions along with the conservative canada endangered species will prove useful he takes the work of the others who explored fragment theory before him and he updates it to include the reformcanadian alliance dynamic i thought it would be interesting to look at the last election through the lens of this paper given the recent political trends of a reformalliance dominated conservative party a recently electorallydevastated ndp and a liberal party that has the potential to morph into something resembling the old progressive conservative party as leuprecht says in the abstract support for the reform partycanadian alliance is most robust in provinces marked by immigration from the western united states by contrast provinces where united empire loyalists settled have proven most resistant to incursions by reform using fragment theory to formulate a possible hypothesis to explain this puzzle has two incidental benefits it probes the failure of new federal parties to emerge from maritime canada and it allows speculation about the simultaneous demise of the conservative and new democratic parties leuprechts paper mentions atlantic canada and the maritimes but never newfoundland alone so to set the stage let me explain some of the subtle differences between newfoundland culture and maritime culture that ive noticed from my own personal experiences if you have one take away from this part of the essay as far as the broader atlantic canadian political culture is concerned i hope its the awareness that people in atlantic canada are very keen to remember the sacrifices of previous generations for different reasons disadvantaged were the people of the province after my speech two elderly ladies approached and informed me that they had enjoyed listening to me though they did not agree with me and added softly and solemnly what you must understand young man is that on this island one can be poor with dignity i did not argue for it was obvious that they were describing themselves lewis goes on to argue in his proud lebanese ukrainian italian trinidadian guyanese or czech heritages within my own community or extended family thinking of rural voters in nova scotia as being something akin to an impoverished aristocracy and the working class against the increasing power of the merchants and the new industrialists he promoted the view that landed interests should use their power and privilege to protect the poor from exploitation by the market conditions in canada were very different from those in england but atlantic tories still had a strong sense that it was the duty of the powerful to protect the why most creators are underpaid and its not because their content isnt good ive been thinking a lot about creator monetization lately especially as i spend more time exploring new creatorfocused tools and ecosystems like base and one realization really stood out to me most creators arent underpaid because their content lacks value theyre underpaid because the current system doesnt know how to price creativity on todays social platforms content itself isnt what gets paid for whats being sold is attention when i publish a post or a video advertisers arent buying my ideas or effort theyre bidding on the attention surrounding the content and platforms decide how much that attention is worth as a result my income as a creator often has very little to do with how impactful or highquality my work is instead it depends on things like where my audience lives how valuable that region is to advertisers and how much brands are willing to pay to interrupt people two creators can generate the same engagement and watch time yet earn completely different amounts for a long time that felt normal to me now it feels fundamentally broken when you compare this to other creative industries the difference is obvious artists sell their work directly musicians earn money every time their songs are played authors get paid through book sales reprints and adaptations in all of those cases the creative output is treated as an asset with a market but internet posts dont work that way they get likes views and shares metrics that look impressive but dont directly translate into value a post can be educational entertaining or massively viral and still earn almost nothing thats why even large creators rely so heavily on brand deals and that tells us something important content is worth far more than what platforms typically pay for it this is where the idea of attention markets started to make sense to me in an attentionbased model value comes from the audience not advertisers people can express belief in a creator or even a specific post prices move based on attention momentum and demand instead of platforms capturing all the upside creators and their communities participate directly in the value they create what i find interesting about platforms experimenting in this space especially on base is that theyre exploring a different relationship between creators and audiences markets tied to creator profiles or individual posts audiences becoming participants rather than passive viewers revenue driven by real engagement not intermediaries to me this feels bigger than just crypto it looks like a structural shift in how creative work can be valued in the digital age millions of people want to create because its meaningful but theres still a massive gap between the value creators generate and the value theyre able to capture if attention itself can become a market that gap starts to close im genuinely curious what others think should online content be treated more like an asset would you support or trade around creators directly if the tools existed or does the advertising model still make more sense to you interested to hear different perspectives

the witch house the witchs room has slanted impossible angles that are actually gateways into higher dimensions in at the mountains of madness the alien citys architecture warps scale direction and spatial intuition until the explorers feel physically and psychologically unmoored in the nameless city even the proportions of corridors feel wrong producing dread before anything supernatural appears in all of these cases geometry becomes a form of cosmic communication noneuclidean forms act like messages or warnings carved into space itself expressing truths too alien for human language taking that idea and applying it directly to control resonant the intrusive pattern could be interpreted as a higherdimensional entity that communicates not through sound like the hiss or language but through the distortion of spatial logic instead of being another resonance contagion or a traditional antagonist it could be something like a mathematical infection an extradimensional pattern that tries to impose its own geometry onto our world rather than corrupting minds it corrupts the rules that describe how space is arranged this is where the lovecraft influence becomes most useful the intrusive pattern could operate the way rlyehs angles do a structure that cannot exist in three dimensions but is trying to force itself into them anyway its attack is the misalignment of reality corridors that lead into themselves objects pinched into impossible shapes rooms folding inward like higherorder polygons the intrusive pattern could function as a third cosmic force distinct from both the board and anything else seen before its goal wouldnt be conquest or communication but alignment its trying to impose its own geometric order on our dimension the way a more complex organism grows into a simpler one where the hiss tunes things into its frequency the intrusive pattern reshapes things into its form this could produce layouts where space repeats in loops because the pattern is trying to complete itself or its just a form of containment d

constellation a space exploration game with threejs i was playing paradox games for a decade and this year decided to try to build a prototype of the next grand space strategy in space instead of just thinking about it and writing ideas on the forums i built a playable prototype using threejs in my game you are starting in a procedurally generated star system and you just discovered an ancient network of gates connecting it to other stars there is no pregenerated galaxy every star system is generated at the moment of contact with increasing chance over time to meet other players my goal was to create a variety and make every connection valuable so that a player knows their constellation and travels back and forth in the network of tunnels to manage mining energy production research and new settlements generating stars this way allows for highly asymmetric civilizations that may meet at any point and decide to collaborate and trade or compete for domination i like the feeling of opening a tunnel to a brand new star system not knowing what awaits you on the other side i also liked the idea that if you connected to someone hostile you could blow up the tunnel and block access to your part of the space for a while the whole idea of managing tunnels and gates was inspired by vorkosigan saga by lois mcmaster bujold every habitable planet is very valuable and represents a major opportunity to expand and is currently the only source of science output and is very hard to defend most of the economy happens in space mining asteroids and getting energy currently there are only two ways to get energy in the game mine helium 3 as a fast and cheap way to get some energy and build dyson swarms as a more expensive but much more scalable way to meet energy needs energy is a capacity not a storable resource the prototype is still in its infancy i just added technology and basic conflict for controlling the gates working on planetary invasions planning to spend the holidays fixing the bugs and implementing things like space lifts and relics to research im a designer and this whole project is vibecoded with claude in cursor im looking for anyone interested in contributing to the game with ideas code art or music maybe we could bootstrap it to a point where paradox would get interested in some of the ideas the code for the project is opensourced of course if you want to try it please check out it currently runs on a raspberry pi in my home office in hong kong so it could be a bit slow and janky but it should work the ui is optimized for a desktop or
